m.aarti.tek: Perform the āratī of Śrī Naṭavara, the best of dancers, the holder of Mount Govardhana and holder of the flute.
m.aarti.pad1: Son of Nanda, Yaśodā's darling, Gopāla dear to the cows and the gopīs, dear to the gods, death to the demons — perform the āratī of Mohana, the best, who enchants the world.
m.aarti.pad2: Victory to the son of Vasudeva and Devakī! Destroyer of Kālayavana, Kaṃsa and the rest, support of the world, unconquered, worshipped by the world — perform the āratī of the one ever new and supremely beautiful.
m.aarti.pad3: Without parts, bearer of the kalās (divine powers), upholder of the whole universe; who nourishes the universe, granter of desires, mine of compassion; ageless, deathless, master of māyā and remover of māyā — perform the āratī of the one beyond the guṇas, made of consciousness, the abode of every virtue.
m.aarti.pad4: Protector of Parīkṣit, offspring of the Pāṇḍavas; the matchless one, who swallowed Agha the serpent as if he were a mouse; pervading the world, the world's desireless witness — perform the āratī of Brahman, higher than the highest, the Supreme Lord.
m.aarti.pad5: Eternal, true, who sports in Goloka; unborn, unmanifest, who takes a body for his līlā (divine play); full of play, who spreads his play far and wide — perform the āratī of Rādhā's beloved, sweet and enchanting.
